result.rationale: The diff replaces the old automatic-group-only pagination (default limit 200) with `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` applied to ALL groups with no upper cap, and `total = group.users.count` plus full serialization of the result. A client can pass limit=1000000 and force serialization of every member of a huge group (e.g. trust_level_0) in one unauthenticated-ish public request — a real, verifiable resource-exhaustion defect introduced by this change.

record.issue_text: app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — Client-supplied limit on public members endpoint is uncapped, so limit=1000000 on a huge automatic group (e.g. trust_level_0) loads and serializes every member in one request.

adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the `limit` is taken directly from `params[:limit]` (`limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`) and then used in `group.users...limit(limit)` with no upper bound. This allows a client to request an extremely large `limit` (e.g. 1000000), causing the server to query and serialize a huge number of users in one response. The diff also removed the prior special-casing for automatic groups and now applies this client-controlled limit logic universally.
